attr.title: OneShot World Machine Edition
attr.desc: A puzzle adventure about Niko, a child who wakes in a dying world holding a lightbulb that is meant to become its new sun. The game knows you are there, and treats you as someone separate from Niko. It talks to you, remembers you, and eventually asks you to decide what a world gets to do with its only chance. World Machine Edition rebuilds the original's habit of reaching outside its own window into a simulated desktop you explore between chapters, so none of it touches your real machine. Soft pixel art, a quiet score, and an ending that plays once.
attr.inst: Buy and install OneShot: World Machine Edition on Steam. Copy the whole contents of the game's install folder into the oneshotwme/gamedata folder. Run OneShot. The first launch patches the game, which takes a moment.
attr.inst_md:
- Buy and install OneShot: World Machine Edition on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915460/OneShot_World_Machine_Edition/)
- Copy the **whole contents** of the game's install folder into the `oneshotwme/gamedata` folder.
- Run OneShot. The first launch patches the game, which takes a moment.
